gate-inputs.enabled.description: GX-23 (B-15, GA-P10, D-070): the lint, typecheck, unit tests and integration tests caches key on the inputs declared in scripts/lib/gate-stage-inputs.json (plus its traced read set) instead of the whole tree. Off is the rollback: lint and typecheck key on every tracked file and the stages on their gate-stages.json inputs, byte for byte as before GX-23.

gate-inputs.schema_version.description: Version of the declared-inputs schema (scripts/lib/gate-stage-inputs.json). It is part of every narrowed key, so a change in how inputs are read misses every narrowed cache entry without bumping gate.stage_cache_version.
